parts:
On 06/10/2016 01:22 PM, Kamakshaiah Musunuru wrote:
> Hi,
> I am performing structural equation modeling on certain data set which
> has 133 rows and 67 variables. The output gives me error as below:
>
> > lavaan(d.model, d.df)
> Error in lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats =
> lavsamplestats, :
> lavaan ERROR: initial model-implied matrix (Sigma) is not positive
> definite;
> check your model and/or starting parameters.

Try:

fit <- lavaan(d.model)
fitted(fit)

to see the model-implied covariance matrix.

If you are a beginner, I would suggest to use the sem() function instead.

> If I use the below code it gives me output but I am not sure if I am
> correct or not?
>
> lavaan(div.la.mod, d.df, auto.fix.first = TRUE, auto.var = TRUE)
You do not tell us which model you wish to fit, so we don't know.

> One more thing. How can I save the output (from "summary(lavaan.fit)" in
> spreadsheet. Is there a way? just like

summary() is for 'display' only. Use parameterEstimates() to get a
data.frame (which you can save).

Yves.
